description: This file contains utility functions and checks related to model validation, routing, and fallback mechanisms for the litellm proxy authorization module. It includes functions for model wildcard checks, provider model retrieval, access group processing, and fallback retrievals.

methods.name: bool _check_wildcard_routing(model: str)
methods.description: Checks if the given model string contains a wildcard character indicating provider wildcard routing.

methods.name: Optional[List[str]] get_provider_models( provider: str, litellm_params: Optional[LiteLLM_Params] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of known models for a specific provider, optionally filtered by litellm parameters.

methods.name: List[str] _get_models_from_access_groups( model_access_groups: Dict[str, List[str]], all_models: List[str], include_model_access_groups: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Filters and extends model list based on access groups.

methods.name: List[str] get_mcp_server_ids( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, )
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches MCP server IDs associated with a user's API key.

methods.name: List[str] get_key_models( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, proxy_model_list: List[str], model_access_groups: Dict[str, List[str]], include_model_access_groups: Optional[bool] = False, only_model_access_groups: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Returns models associated with a user API key, considering access groups and special model names.

methods.name: List[str] get_team_models( team_models: List[str], proxy_model_list: List[str], model_access_groups: Dict[str, List[str]], include_model_access_groups: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Returns models associated with a team, considering access groups and special model names.

methods.name: List[str] get_complete_model_list( key_models: List[str], team_models: List[str], proxy_model_list: List[str], user_model: Optional[str], infer_model_from_keys: Optional[bool], return_wildcard_routes: Optional[bool] = False, llm_router: Optional[Router] = None, model_access_groups: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}, include_model_access_groups: Optional[bool] = False, only_model_access_groups: Optional[bool] = False, )
methods.description: Generates a comprehensive list of models based on key, team, proxies, and other filters.

methods.name: List[str] get_known_models_from_wildcard( wildcard_model: str, litellm_params: Optional[LiteLLM_Params] = None )
methods.description: Resolves models based on a wildcard model string, fetching provider models and handling partial filters.

methods.name: List[str] _get_wildcard_models( unique_models: List[str], return_wildcard_routes: Optional[bool] = False, llm_router: Optional[Router] = None, )
methods.description: Identifies wildcard models in a list and expands them into known provider models.

methods.name: List[str] get_all_fallbacks( model: str, llm_router: Optional[Router] = None, fallback_type: str = "general", )
methods.description: Retrieves fallback models for a given model from the router configuration.
